theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (V δ : ℝ) (η : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V) → 0 < δ → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η → HasCompactSupport η → (∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) → (∀ z, η (-z) = η z) → ∫ z, η z = 1 → support η ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) δ → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (convolution η (Set.indicator {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} u) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) ∧ ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ‖fderiv ℝ (convolution η (Set.indicator {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} u) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x‖ ≤ V
